title: Refining an analytical essay
log: 2026-11-12T12:44:15Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: The new point is a whole-essay revision checklist covering thesis support, explained evidence, concise expression and conclusions, while the closest bank point, Conclusions, covers only what a conclusion should contain, so no bank point teaches the same idea at the same breadth.

draft.title: Refining an analytical essay
card: Refining is the check you do after a draft is written. You reread the essay against your thesis and fix what does not serve it.
Every paragraph must help prove the thesis. A paragraph that drifts to a new topic, or only retells the plot, should be cut or reworked.
Each piece of evidence needs explaining. Check that you name the technique and say how it shapes the reader's understanding, rather than leaving a quotation to speak for itself.
Cut repeated ideas, filler and long-winded phrases so each sentence earns its place. The conclusion should show where the argument has arrived, not copy the introduction.
draft.remember: Refine by testing each part against the thesis: focused, explained, concise, and a conclusion that adds something.

a.q: Zara is refining her essay. Which change would best improve a paragraph that only retells what happens in the story?
opts: Rework it to explain how techniques support her thesis
Add a longer plot summary so readers follow the events
Move the paragraph to the end to act as a conclusion
Replace some words with longer, more formal vocabulary
a.why: Refining checks that each paragraph supports the thesis, so a retelling paragraph needs analysis linked to the argument. More summary or fancier words would not fix the lack of focus.
a.clue: Ask what the paragraph does for the thesis.

b.q: Liam's conclusion repeats his introduction almost word for word. Which revision best fits the aim of refining?
opts: Show what his analysis has revealed about the text's ideas
Add a new quotation to prove his first body paragraph
Make the conclusion longer by restating each paragraph
Delete the conclusion so the essay ends on analysis
b.why: A refined conclusion does more than repeat, so it should show where the argument has arrived. Restating each paragraph is still repetition, and adding a quotation belongs in a body paragraph.
b.clue: The conclusion should move beyond what was already said.

a.best: Rework it to explain how techniques support her thesis

b.best: Show what his analysis has revealed about the text's ideas
